Context: 9. Subsistence Allowance

- GIO (1) of CCS (CCA), Chapter 4, FR 53 1 (ii) (a).  
Subsistence Allowance to be reviewed after 3 months and may be % of the allowance during the first 3 months or reduced  
increased by up to 50 by up to 50% of the allowance during the first 3 months.  
- FR 53 1 (ii) (a) - (i) and (ii).
